records.summary: In its own Annual Report for the financial year ended 30 June 2024, the Central Bank of Samoa discloses in the Staffing section (VIII.2.1) that one of its staff was dismissed for irregularities. The Bank employed 102 staff at 30 June 2024; seven others resigned to move overseas, and one member of staff was terminated. The Bank is reporting conduct by its own employee, and it does not name the person or set out what the irregularities were.
records.source_title: Central Bank of Samoa Annual Report 2023-2024, Section VIII.2.1 Staffing
records.quote: with one (1) staff who was terminated due to staff irregularities
